tasks.instruction_text: Find **Educational** events that are **Free** — apply the Topic (Educational) and Price (Free) chips in the hero pill cluster.

Mirror the Eventbrite request: **school-activity events in New York for this month**. Apply Topic chip (Educational) + Date chip (This month) + Price chip (Free). Verify all three pills sit in the hero pill cluster before reading off the list.
Apply **Educational** + **This month** + **Free** + **NYC DOE** (host). After all four pills are in the hero cluster, × off the NYC DOE host chip so the host is unconstrained.
Cross-compare two topics: apply **Educational** AND **Family** under Topic, plus **This weekend** date. Then × off the Family chip so the cluster shows Educational + This weekend only.
No filters — how many events total are listed on EventStream?
Without filtering, which event has the highest rating, and what's the rating?
No filters — count free events versus paid events.
Apply the **STEM** (topic) chip AND the **Paid** (price) chip. After both pills sit in the pill cluster, tell me how many paid STEM events are listed.

Multi-step replay: apply **Educational** + **This month** + **Paid** + **NYC DOE** (host). Then × off the Paid chip so price is unconstrained. Tell me how many NYC-DOE Educational events this month remain.
Apply **Family** (topic) + **Free** (price) + **This weekend** (date). Once all three pills are in the hero cluster, name the highest-rated free family event this weekend (title + rating).
